onboarding.title: Let's set up your learning
onboarding.intro: Three quick steps. You can change all of this later in Settings.
onboarding.language_hint: This is the language of the app. Chinese lessons always stay in Chinese.
onboarding.name: What should we call you? (optional)
onboarding.name_hint: Only shown to you inside the app. You can leave it empty.
onboarding.minutes_title: How much time can you study each day?
onboarding.minutes_hint: Pick what feels easy. If it turns out too much or too little, the app can suggest a change, but nothing changes until you say yes.
onboarding.data_intro: To run your plan we store your quiz answers, your daily tasks and whether you finished them, the reasons you tell us when you stop, your plan and its changes, and the ratings you give. You can download or delete all of it at any time in Settings.
onboarding.consent_required: I agree that Huayu Coach stores and uses my study data, as described above, to run my learning plan.
onboarding.consent_llm: Optional: if the operator turns on AI wording, send anonymous study facts (such as the reason code, plan numbers and counts; never my name, e-mail or note) to an AI provider chosen by the operator, so it can write an extra explanation.
onboarding.consent_llm_hint: Off by default. Numbers and suggestions are always decided by fixed rules; AI text is shown in addition to the suggestions and cannot change them. Without this, you get the same suggestions with standard wording. You can change your mind anytime in Settings.
onboarding.llm_inactive: AI wording is not switched on in this app right now, so nothing is sent. If the operator switches it on later, your choice here applies from then on, and you can change it in Settings at any time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Display name (optional)
settings.timezone_hint: Your study day starts at midnight in this time zone.
settings.ai_on: On: anonymous study facts (such as the reason code, plan numbers and counts; never your name, e-mail or note) may be sent to an AI provider chosen by the operator to write an extra explanation.
settings.ai_off: Off: nothing is sent to an AI provider.
settings.ai_note: Numbers and suggestions are always decided by fixed rules, never by AI. AI text is shown in addition to them.
settings.password_hint: You stay logged in on this device. Every other device will be logged out.
settings.data_hint: Download the data the app stores about you as one file (JSON): profile, answers, plan, stuck reports, suggestions, ratings, consents, payments, and the admin-log entries about your account.
settings.delete_warning: This permanently deletes your account and all your study data. It cannot be undone. Only payment records (kept for bookkeeping, no longer linked to you) and a minimal admin-log entry remain; the privacy notice has the details.

err.name_long: The name can have at most {max_name} characters.
err.locale_invalid: Please choose one of the languages in the list.
err.timezone_invalid: Please choose one of the time zones in the list.
err.consent_required: Please tick the first box. Without it we cannot set up your plan.
err.minutes_invalid: Please choose how long you can study each day.
err.current_password_wrong: Your current password is not correct.
err.password_same: The new password must be different from the current one.
err.last_admin: You are the only administrator, so this account cannot be deleted.

flash.password_changed: Password changed. This device stays logged in; all other devices were logged out.
flash.consent_on: Saved. If the operator has switched AI wording on, study facts may be used to word explanations.
flash.consent_off: Saved. Nothing will be sent to an AI provider.
flash.deleted: Your account and study data have been deleted. Thank you for learning with us.
